authors: J. Davies, F. Herren, A.E. Thomsen
title: General gauge-Yukawa-quartic beta-functions at 4-3-2-loop order
claim: All coefficients of the general 4-loop gauge and 3-loop Yukawa beta functions (510 unknowns) from new diagrammatic computations in SM-adjacent models plus 266 WCC, without using the T_IJ symmetry conjecture (thereby verifying it at 4-3-2). gamma5-odd contributions are ignored in the new computations; the 5 gamma5-odd Yukawa structures are fixed by matching to SM/2HDM results where odd traces were evaluated in 4 dimensions; the 4 gamma5-odd gauge structures (g199-g202) are completely predicted by the WCC from the 3-loop Yukawa ones, confirming R = 3. At 5-4-3 it is not clear whether the full determination of gamma5-odd coefficients from unambiguous terms can be repeated (Sec. 4).
scheme: MS-bar; gamma5-odd traces evaluated in 4d for the Yukawa input; WCC for gauge gamma5-odd terms

proved: full 4-3-2 coefficient set (Tab. 1-3, App. A-D), consistent with redundant constraints and with S5.20
assumed: WCC validity (Osborn's equation as derived in Poole-Thomsen) in the gamma5 sector
completeness of the tensor-structure basis; 'single point of failure' shared with S5.20 (same parametrization and RGBeta implementation), as the authors concede

red_flags: explicit statement that the gamma5-odd sector at 5-4-3 loops is open
Yukawa beta is scheme-dependent beyond two loops (flavour improvement, Hermitian square roots of Z factors)
